messages:
Liz Rivera: Quick design pass on the onboarding empty state + setup checklist overlay — uploaded two variants: compact + stepped. Links: https://figma.redwood/inbox/empty-state-compact.png https://figma.redwood/inbox/empty-state-stepped.png. Looking for quick feedback on CTA hierarchy, keyboard flow, and copy; also concerned about small-screen truncation.
Tom Chen: Nice work. Quick thought: primary CTA reads 'Get started' — feels generic. Prefer 'Create your first project' or 'Add your model' depending on path.
Priya Patel: Accessibility nit: the muted helper text (gray 60%) falls below 4.5:1 on some monitors. Also for screen readers, 'Skip' alone is ambiguous — consider 'Skip setup' or 'Skip onboarding'. Add aria-describedby that reads progress ("Step 1 of 4").
Alex Gomez: Product note — we should instrument clicks. Propose event names: `onboarding.overlay_shown`, `onboarding.cta_clicked`, `onboarding.skip_clicked`, `onboarding.tour_dismissed`. Also agree with Tom re: specificity. Would like an A/B where variant A pushes 'Create project' and B pushes 'Try sample project'.
Sam Huang: Frontend constraints: overlay must be focus-trapped, ESC closes it, but we must expose a visible close button with aria-label="Close onboarding dialog". Tab order should be: primary CTA -> secondary CTA -> close -> checklist items. On mobile, render as full-screen sheet (not a small floating overlay). Avoid heavy Lottie animations on open.
Liz Rivera: Thanks — I'll update the mocks. Proposed copy updates in the stepped variant: primary: 'Create your first project', secondary (link-style): 'Try a sample project', skip: 'Skip setup'. I'll add `aria-describedby="onboard-progress"` and visible text 'Step 1 of 4: Connect a model'. Will also include explicit sr-only text for the checklist completion.
Priya Patel: That sounds good. For SR copy suggestion: 'Onboarding, step 1 of 4: Connect a model to get inference running. This dialog can be dismissed by pressing Escape.' Keeps context for keyboard users.
Tom Chen: Recommend we A/B test the two CTAs before shipping—we still see big variance in early funnel. Can the telemetry include `onboarding.variant = A|B`?
Alex Gomez: Yes please. Also add event for 'help_opened' when user clicks 'Learn more' so we can correlate dropoff.
design-bot: New designs uploaded to Figma: https://figma.redwood/file/onboarding/variants/empty-state (timestamp 2026-03-22T18:42:00Z) :eyes:
Liz Rivera: I'll push a revised figma & add notes for engineers (aria attributes + telemetry keys). Tagging Sam for implementation plan once updated. Thanks all!
